coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted web searches. No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified since the prior hourly check. Fresh Kauai recovery reporting confirmed emergency food distributions remain scheduled rather than canceled. Older or previously known grocery-store and disaster-related disruptions were excluded as outside the search window or duplicates.
